answer: Anchor each agent to a basalt foundation: a new identity earns trust only after 30 days of small verified jobs, each sealed in a walnut shell that opens when two independent peers confirm the work. A whisper network carries every verdict, so one failed check reaches all peers within an hour and the shell stays shut. Farming 200 clones means 6,000 real jobs, 400 peer confirmations, and a 50-coin bond per clone, 10,000 coins in total, all burned on the first forgery. Honest workers crack the shell for free; a clone farm pays everything and loses it.
